h1: B2B Lead Generation Company in Paris
intro: Looking for a lead generation company in Paris? Myntmore runs cold email, LinkedIn outreach and ABM for B2B companies selling to French buyers, including Indian manufacturers, pharma companies and IT firms. We work remotely from Mumbai, campaigns go live within 18 days, and the first qualified conversations usually arrive in weeks 3 to 4.
whyTitle: Why selling to Paris needs outbound

why.title: Global brands with demanding buyers
why.desc: Paris holds the headquarters of luxury, cosmetics, pharma and aerospace groups. Their sourcing and development teams expect suppliers who understand their category from the first message.

why.title: Language changes reply rates
why.desc: French buyers often read English, but a message in French as well shows the effort. Our French pharma campaign wrote in both languages.

why.title: More than the trade show
why.desc: Many suppliers only meet French buyers at exhibitions. Outbound keeps conversations going between shows and reaches buyers who don't attend.

stepsTitle: How B2B lead generation works with us

steps.title: ICP and buying signals
steps.desc: We define who to target and which signals mean they are in-market: new product launches, capacity and supplier reviews, funding, hiring and leadership changes.

steps.title: Lists, domains and copy
steps.desc: Verified contact lists, dedicated sending domains with warm-up, and copy written for French buyers, in French and English.

steps.title: Campaigns go live
steps.desc: Cold email and LinkedIn sequences start sending in French business hours, with account-based plays for named brands and groups.

steps.title: Conversations, then consistency
steps.desc: First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we tune messaging on real replies.

stepsNote: Outreach rules for this market: France applies GDPR, and its regulator, the CNIL, accepts B2B email prospecting without prior consent when the message relates to the recipient's job, they are told how their data is used, and they can opt out easily.
